sentences.japanese: 猿はたくさん芸を覚える。
sentences.english: Monkeys can learn a lot of tricks.

sentences.japanese: この猿は、きちんと仕込めばいろいろな芸ができるようになるだろう。
sentences.english: The monkey, trained properly, will be able to do a lot of tricks.

sentences.japanese: 老犬に新しい芸は仕込めない。
sentences.english: You can't teach an old dog new tricks.

sentences.japanese: 老犬に新しい芸は教えられない。
sentences.english: You can't teach an old dog new tricks.

sentences.japanese: 僕はサーカスで見事な動物の芸を見た。
sentences.english: I saw a marvelous animal act at the circus.
